mapper.select:
SELECT balance.id AS receivableId, balance.receivable_no AS receivableNo, balance.order_no AS orderNo, balance.customer_name_snapshot AS customerName, balance.amount, balance.red_amount AS redAmount, balance.net_amount AS netAmount, balance.written_off_amount AS writtenOffAmount, balance.open_amount AS openAmount, GREATEST(balance.written_off_amount - balance.net_amount, 0) AS overAppliedAmount, balance.event_at AS eventAt
AND (balance.receivable_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR balance.order_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR balance.customer_name_snapshot ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY balance.event_at DESC, balance.id DESC
